subject: science
domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions

items.prompt:
Gravity is a force that is always:
A) Repulsive
B) Attractive
C) Zero
D) Sideways

steps: Gravity always pulls objects together; it is attractive.

items.prompt:
The strength of gravity depends on the objects':
A) Color
B) Mass
C) Temperature only
D) Names

steps: More mass means a stronger gravitational pull.

items.prompt:
Objects fall toward Earth because Earth has a large:
A) Color
B) Mass
C) Temperature
D) Speed

steps: Earth's large mass creates a strong gravitational pull.

items.prompt:
The gravitational force between the Earth and the Moon is:
A) Repulsive
B) Attractive
C) Zero
D) Sometimes attractive, sometimes not

steps: Gravity between any two masses is attractive.

items.prompt:
Why does the Sun keep the planets in orbit?
A) Its color
B) Its enormous mass creates a strong gravitational pull
C) Its temperature only
D) It pushes the planets
items.answer: B) Its enormous mass creates a strong gravitational pull

steps: The Sun's huge mass produces a strong attractive gravity.

items.prompt:
Planet A has more mass than Planet B at the same distance from a moon. Planet A's gravity is:
A) Weaker
B) Stronger
C) Equal
D) Zero

Which statement about gravity is correct?
A) Gravity can push objects apart
B) Gravity is attractive and depends on the masses of the objects
C) Gravity only acts on Earth
D) Gravity does not depend on mass
items.answer: B) Gravity is attractive and depends on the masses of the objects

steps: Gravity is always attractive and increases with mass.

items.prompt:
Earth's gravity is far stronger than a person's gravity mainly because:
A) Earth is a different color
B) Earth has much more mass
C) People have no mass
D) Earth is closer to the Sun
items.answer: B) Earth has much more mass

steps: Earth's much greater mass gives it a much stronger pull.
